candidateOccurrences.sourceText: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?
